title: Seven Behind One Figure

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The figure goes up seven times and the crack stays showing; the runner carries what she will not read, and the house keeps its grain under wool without a number.
epigraph.attribution: A yard saying of Low Kiln, on Ash's first Account-day

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and thirty-nine to three hundred and forty-one days, six months and one hundred and fifty-nine to one hundred and sixty-one days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. No present-tense break and no tagged memory: the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone. Each morning that register takes the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner standing a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform — and reads the world as a trauma bay is read, by the small sounds first because the small sounds do not lie. He knows the composed face is not composure, knows a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly, never rubbed, never set too near the fire; he knows the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle is louder than the surgeon's knowing, and neither wins, and the argument is the work. Three counts in three places that do not become one, since agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands: the carried fire's four low pulls with its fifth unpaid through three hundred and thirty-nine, forty and forty-one days and its payer unnamed; the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot; the river's water over water, a low thing over a lower thing, never numbered among the hearings. Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the sixth the small flat knock out of a woman as the men lifted her, filed where a thing out of a person must go and never among the sources. The heard bell stays in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night, four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself; the told figure stays beside the paid figure with no signature on the space. Point of view never leaves him: no Court interior, no inside of the collection, no back-room interior, and the Debt Loft only as a sound from above and behind.
places: the flat stone by the well
the reading block under the moot-post

scenes.title: The Tenth Morning
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{339}{Ash 10, Tenthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of the dark month's first Account-day and market, a morning that must earn its own figure. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on answer 252 as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking; the hand outside the wool comes up for the two hundred and fifty-third. No recap of Chapter 95. Carry 338 to 339 exact, six months and 159 days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid 339 days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Nothing from Ash 7, 8 or 9 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment: the Ash 9 pot-crack resting stays on a place of its own beside the five held objects and is expressly not a sixth (T009/T013/T092, T060/T086 held). Body inventory in the surgeon's old order: crust two inches from the ear, stiff and leathery in the dry kiln heat, corner standing a hair off the wool, empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop beyond a warming nobody here will perform. Composed face not composure; a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly; the infant wants the crust lifted two inches, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle. Both true, the second louder, neither wins; the argument is the work (T060/T086). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it* where another woman would say I, counts a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally stays unread, moves her lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, glances once at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack showing, turns the dressed grain under wool with a lighter touch and no figure and no handful, and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077 held). The widow's mark is untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings; six openings in six months are six and not a rule and no seventh is made due (T058/T079). Three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; heard bell beside told; told figure beside paid; file open on the towel with every gap gap. Six arithmetics ride locked in Berr's box under one unsigned figure, figure read not figure paid, six readings six and not one account, the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer; Ash's first belongs to its own morning and is not brought into the small hours (T015/T041/T047 carried). Ash 10 is a date that has arrived, never a promise made to the basket. Answer **253**: hand up an inch toward the river's note, small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, interval held whole, let go on the same low note, straight down as a tool put away; the note had done before the hand came down, so neither early again nor stayed, borrowing no house count and supplying no payer (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The First Reading of Ash
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, chapter's central movement, no new dated heading: the first Account-day and market of Ash, from the carrying-down before first light through the reading at the Cross, the bell, the going of the light and the bed. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Berr Clay, Hessa Rale; walk-ons at the Cross and market (the crowd at the reading block, a woman asking the runner what she carries, a man with a number in his fist), the soft-cuffed clerk set at the out-of-line landing below the north bridge, a green at a silent woman's mouth at the pot board and a shape at the market's edge, both sightings only; Garl in objects. No Ilva, no collector, no ownerless voice, no sixth of any held series. **THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, ADVANCED AND NOT PAID (T015/T041/T047):** Berr comes up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the sweetish green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, wipes his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, holds a narrow slate unopened to his forearm, passes a finger over the figure, reads *One in twelve, as the notice says* low into the goers-by, calls the levy and denies it with *The levy is called. It is not called by me* and *your house*, never I, says something low to the block about kindness being entered, and goes off up the clay road with the box locked and Ash's first true subtraction inside, believing he has done a kindness. **Seven arithmetics of the year — the three of Frost and the first, second and third of Bone and now Ash's first — stand behind one printed figure; seven are seven and not one account**, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space between; the finding is kept on a place of its own with no payer, not laid across the house's not-doings, the dressed grain covered under wool, the five held objects, the pot-crack resting, the handful, the thumb's resting, the two small objects of the hand or the boy's gaps — the edges come near to touching and the finger goes between (T015/T041/T047 advanced, nothing paid). Sella sets the basket in the moot-post's finger's width of shade where no slate lay, keeps the half-pace from every open slate and the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, stands half a pace off through the reading and the bell, gives no instruction or reason to the basket, and carries him home at the going of the light saying nothing. Hessa takes the slate up the clay road before noon, her hand to the slate before her eyes to the crowd, the writing turned to her sleeve and edge-on, the second strap let out and dried pale scurf of road-mud unbrushed on the shortened skirt; to a woman who asks what she carries she says the question put, not the one behind it, and no figure comes off the slate. She is a runner and not a reader, her eighth hand stays eighth with no tenth, and the Ash 6 turning of her writing stays a sighting beside the fourth shaping with a finger between; she is joined to no voice and not made a reader by the reading (T080 held). The bell goes four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, the heard bell kept in its square beside the told; the soft-cuffed clerk stays set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called, his slate inward, hand to slate before eye to stalls (T078, T090 held). A green at a woman's mouth and a shape at the market's edge are seen as sightings only, a seventh of each with no eighth, never named, no loaf, slate, sale, hearing, cause or romance, no joining to Berr's green or to each other (T050/T051, T033/T034 held). At home the hearth grammar holds at both ends of the day: the widow's mark untouched because a reading is not an opening; the grain covered and unfigured and read over by a figure that does not know what it cost; the pot's crack left showing; Garl's absence kept in objects and his name unspoken 339 days. Answer **254** at the very end: small intake let go whole on the river's note, the note having done before the hand came down (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Morning After the Figure
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and second dated \daymark{340}{Ash 11, Firstday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail roof into the first light of an ordinary Firstday with no market, Cross or bell. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl in objects. No Ilva, no Tarn, no Jorra, no Hessa, no collector on stage this morning. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Ash 10 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment — the reading went up where readings go up and answered nothing under this roof. Carry 339 to 340 exact, six months and 160 days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid 340 days, payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order; composed face not composure; a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly; surgeon versus infant quarrel, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the argument the work (T060/T086). Hearth grammar holds: fire before basket; coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot; *The house will keep it*; intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured; finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread; lips along a two-gapped row unfigured; one glance at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air; twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack showing; dressed grain turned under wool with a lighter touch and no figure and no handful; pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). The widow's mark is untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings; six openings in six months are six and not a rule and no seventh is made due (T058/T079). Seven arithmetics now stand behind one unsigned figure, seven readings seven and not one account, the finding on a place of its own with no payer and not laid across the not-doings, the covered grain, the five held objects, the pot-crack resting or his gaps; no eighth arithmetic is due on a day that has not earned one (T015/T041/T047 carried). The Ash 5 joining, the fourth shaping and the Ash 6 turning stay on separate places with a finger between and none made again; the burned slate stays at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings, the well-saying at four shapings with Hessa's turned writing beside it and Ilva's ninth hand nine with the strip unread — no sixth, third, fifth or tenth of any of them (T035/T031/T065/T095, T080, T101 held). Three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; heard bell beside told; file open on the towel with every gap gap. Ash 20 (Day 349), the month's second Account-day, stands nine mornings ahead, named only as a date and never brought in. Answer **255**: hand up an inch, small intake, interval held whole, let go on the same low note, straight down as a tool put away; neither early again nor stayed (T061/T082).

scenes.title: What the Well Answers
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Ash 11 through the going of the light and the small hours at the yard well and flat stone, seven walked-around places, rack end, kindling, flagstones, wheel-shed edge and damper, back room from outside, and the bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Ilva (once at the well, strip unread, ninth hand nine), Tarn, Jorra Vail; a woman asking at the well; walk-ons (Cold Acre hare-carrier, cracked-jar man); Garl in objects. No Hessa, no Berr, no collector, no market, no Cross, no bell. Nothing from the reading crosses into the yard as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment. Ilva draws at the yard well with the pail against her knee, rope stiff in the Ash cold giving its small dry rasp as the bucket comes up, clay dried pale in the crescents of her nails and the finer grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb she does not scrub out; her hands know the weight of a pail and the edge of a wet board and have never been soft, and people notice the pail first and the sleeve not at all. A woman asks what Ash's first reading took. Ilva's hand goes toward her sleeve and stays; the short notched strip of birch bark, pale where a thumb has rubbed the notches and dark in the uncut grain between, is not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate a pace away, the charcoal beneath the loaf shelf, the cord, the knot-string or any ownerless saying, and no figure comes off the wood. Eyes to the asker, mouth opening after both with a half-beat: *Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account* — the question put and not the one behind it. Flat hand once more on the sleeve and back to the pail, nobody turning twice. The boy takes the order of reaching apart as a surgical field is taken apart and files it as the **ninth** record-first hand on its own place with a finger between it and Hessa Rale's eighth; he files **no tenth**, makes no figure of the slate's nearness, makes her no reader of her own keeping and joins her to none (T080 held, advanced and not paid). **There is no ownerless saying at this well:** Ilva is expressly not the speaker of any voice, the well-saying stays at four shapings with no fifth, the Ash 6 turning stays a sighting and not a prophecy, and the runner is not made a reader by the day's count kept in wood. The yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number (clean dark line and finer grey thaw unswept, lowest rack and broken birth-slates, gone pan's round ring, trough's skin, field's empty place on the worked strips, the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out); three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between pairs; hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T083/T085 held, T077 held). At the rack end the dressed grain lies turned under wool and her fingers go in and come out without closing, so no handful is lifted (T077). Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, knife at the edge of its sill, *Six counted. The next I don't count*, ear-sentence to the calling word and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent, chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases the colour of the clean dark line, pale clip-ring holding light, stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot and unreconciled by not trying; the thumb's resting of Bone 26 is checked and **not made again on Ash 11** — not a tenth stopping, not the seventh year given, not a payment, not a sixth held change, not a hearing, not a mending and not a rule, with no payer standing (T036/T076/T006 held). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door off the wheel-shed with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent finger and white in a fist-crease, not bone-coloured slip; dusty forearms parted from clean as clot from vessel; men unnamed went low into the back room before first grey and get no name and he does not say the room is cold; wheel first — *It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady* — then *You'll do* to a pot; the full note known three turns ahead is withheld from any High Kiln master who would call it early and make a song of it; bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, one piece of iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies; *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn; burned slate at five with the Ash 5 joining held apart, shut-room tellings at two, row at five with no sixth due on a day that has not earned one (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095 held, T101 held). Garl stays in objects with his name unspoken 340 days and his tile debt uncalled. Sella carries him up at the going of the light at the half-pace, fold righted without a look at his face, thread left, never the Debt Loft. Answer **256** at the very end: small intake let go whole on the river's note; the note had done before the hand came down (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Twelfth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and third dated \daymark{341}{Ash 12, Secondday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Secondday with no market, Cross or bell. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl in objects. No Ilva, no Tarn, no Jorra, no Hessa, no collector on stage this morning. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Ash 11 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment. Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order: crust two inches from the ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, gone leathery in the dry kiln heat; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a written line; the afterdrop beyond a warming nobody here will perform. Composed face not composure; a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly; infant wants crust lifted, thread wiped, hand on pot handle — both true, the second louder, neither winning, the argument the work (T060/T086). Hearth grammar holds the morning of the twelfth: fire before basket; coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot; *The house will keep it*; intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured; finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread; lips along a two-gapped row unfigured; one glance at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air; twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack showing; dressed grain turned under wool with a lighter touch and no figure and no handful; pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). Widow's mark untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings; six openings in six months are six and not a rule and no seventh is made due. Seven arithmetics ride locked in Berr's box under one unsigned figure, figure read not figure paid, seven readings seven and not one account, the finding on a place of its own with no payer and not laid across the not-doings, the covered grain, the five held objects, the pot-crack resting or his gaps (T015/T041/T047 carried). The five held objects and the pot-crack resting beside them (expressly not a sixth), the three Ash 5/6 movements, Ilva's ninth strip unread and Hessa's eighth unread stay each on its own place with a finger between and none made again. Ash 20 (Day 349), the month's second Account-day and market, stands eight mornings ahead and is named only as a date, never a promise; no eighth arithmetic, sixth telling, third shut-room telling, fifth shaping, tenth hand or tenth stopping is due on a day that has not earned it. Answer **257**: hand up an inch toward the river's note, small intake, interval held whole, let go on the same low note, straight down as a tool put away; neither early again nor stayed (T061/T082).

scenes.title: Seven and Not One Account
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 341, Ash 12, the afternoon at the Clay Yard, seven walked-around places, rack end, yard well and flat stone, kindling, flagstones, wheel-shed edge and damper, the hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; walk-ons (Cold Acre hare-carrier, cracked-jar man, woman with basket of kindling, two men mending a strip of fence, a woman with a cost-question); Garl in objects. No Ilva, no Hessa, no Berr, no green-mouthed woman, no foundling at the close, no collector up or down the clay road, no market, Cross or bell. Ash keeps its twelfth day without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months is corrected. The yard goes around its seven places; the three coverings stay weather; the hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the arm and the weather: Cold Acre hare answered with the weather, cracked jar answered with the pot which says nothing, woman with kindling asking what the seventh year will want and two fence-menders saying the thaw will be early and late, Tarn saying *Yes, house* to each and keeping the late because it puts off the paying (T009/T013/T092, T077, T083/T085 held, T098 carried, T036/T076). At the going of the light the twice-mended pot is lifted thumb-first at the wire and the original hairline is left showing; the Ash 9 held breath at the crossing stays where it was set — one object on its own place beside the staying at the inch, the early letting-go, the handful, the thumb's resting and the sixth opening, expressly not a sixth held object, not made again, not joined to the charcoal, Ilva's strip, the Ash 5 joining, the fourth shaping, the Ash 6 turning, the covered grain or his gaps, with no payer (T009/T013/T092, T060/T086 held, T100 held). The whole tray is checked and left as it lay: six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; heard bell beside told; told figure beside paid with no signature; seven a colour and seven a shape with no eighth; nine record-first hands with Hessa's eighth and Ilva's ninth apart and no tenth; nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end; the row at five askings with no witness and expressly no sixth; the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, and the Ash 5 joining, the fourth shaping and the Ash 6 turning on separate places with a finger between, none spent or paid. **Seven arithmetics of the year stand behind one printed figure — seven are seven and not one account**, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space, the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer and not laid across the house's not-doings, the dressed grain, the five held objects, the handful, the thumb's resting, the two small objects of the hand, the sixth opening, the three Ash 5/6 movements, the pot-crack resting or his gaps; the edges come near to touching and the finger goes between, and no doctrine stands up, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T015/T041/T047 advanced, nothing paid). Garl stays in objects: salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease, hollow wheel-seat nobody fills, clean dark line and finer grey unswept, twice-mended pot with the crack showing and both proverbs gone to pot and fire and never to a person, tile debt neither paid nor settled nor done with and worse for being uncalled, name unspoken 341 days, no lesson made. Sella carries him up at the going of the light at the half-pace, goes wide around the seven places, sets him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face, lets her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed before it goes away, leaves the thread where it lay, says nothing of where they have been, gives the instruction to the fire, wool, pot and river wind and never to the basket, and says *The house will keep it* where another woman would say I. Fire four and a gap; boards four, four and a thumb-width knot; river water over water — three counts in three places and none rises into another, because agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands. Answer **258** at the very end: hand up an inch toward the river's note, small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, interval held whole, let go on the same low note, straight down and laid back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking; the note had done before the hand came down, so neither early again nor stayed; filed as answer 258, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer. **Two hundred and fifty-eight honest answers** stand on the sixth place, each an object and not a power, and neither the number nor the small hand-movings that made it stood up and called themselves a doctrine. The surgeon takes his small clean satisfaction in a field left as found; the infant underneath takes none and wants the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning. 341 stands exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath; six months and 161 days told by nobody; the carried fire's fifth unpaid the same number with its payer unnamed; Garl's name unspoken the same number. Nothing on Ash 12 was opened, joined by a standing hand, named, called, paid or ended. The keeping of the number was the only honest work there was to do, bought nothing at two inches of air and went on because attention is the one thing no institution can tax. The file lies open on the towel with every gap left gap; the twice-mended pot stands on the pot board with the hairline of the break showing between the old-brass staple and the tighter wire; the runner's writing from Ash 6 is turned toward herself up the clay road and no figure has come off any slate; Ash's first arithmetic rides locked and unread in Berr's box behind the six, seven behind one unsigned figure; Ash 20 (Day 349), the month's second Account-day and market, stands eight mornings ahead and is not brought into a day that has not earned it. Forward, not closed; no ending, epilogue or doctrine.
